mechanism: Dexamethasone may enhance sympathomimetic effects of lisdexamfetamine and increase cardiovascular stress; corticosteroids can also mask signs of infection while stimulants increase metabolic demand.
action: Monitor cardiovascular parameters closely; assess for hypertension, tachycardia, and arrhythmias; consider alternative corticosteroid or stimulant if feasible; educate patient on infection risk during concurrent use.
